prompt.text:
Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the four-frame pulse loop of the GYRO — one of the player's orbiting Option pods, a COMPACT roughly SQUARE glowing module that trails the ship in formation. The four cells are the SAME pod turning its spokes over four steps.

Design identity to keep exactly — a spinning rotor GYRO: a SMALL compact badge-wheel of exactly 150 px across in EVERY cell — 150 px from its topmost pixel to its bottommost, 150 px from its leftmost to its rightmost, all four wheels the same 150 px circle at the same dead-centre place in their cells, each with a wide even band of flat key all around it (at least 50 px on every side). A bold amber ring (#f8a030) on a deep crimson outline (#6a1a1a) around a dark hub, with a pair of straight red spokes (#e83838) crossing at the hub. The PLUS wheel is the same 150 px circle as the X wheel: its two spoke bars run straight up-down and left-right, their ends joining the ring's inner edge, every tip staying inside the 150 px circle — same ring, same thickness, same hub. Only the spoke pair turns: 0 the plus, 1 the X, 2 the flare peak (the spokes burn brighter, the ring lights amber-white at its far side), 3 the X again with the far rim lit.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 4 cells laid out as a 2×2 GRID (2-column by 2-row, reading left-right then top-bottom) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject at the same scale and position; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = FRAME 0 — the 150 px wheel with spokes in a PLUS (+) upright cross, arm tips on the ring's inner edge. The subject lies within aspect 0.70:1 to 1.30:1.
  cell 2 = FRAME 1 — the SAME 150 px wheel turned 45 degrees, spokes in an X. The subject lies within aspect 0.70:1 to 1.30:1.
  cell 3 = FRAME 2 FLARE — the SAME 150 px wheel still in the X, the spokes burning brighter. The subject lies within aspect 0.70:1 to 1.30:1.
  cell 4 = FRAME 3 — the SAME 150 px wheel in the X, its far rim lit amber. The subject lies within aspect 0.70:1 to 1.30:1.
- POD SHAPE LAW: the pod is a compact, near-square badge sitting in the middle of its cell — its width and height are equal (the same 150 px both ways). The four cells sit in a 2x2 grid, each pod alone in its cell.
- SAME-SIZE LAW: the pod's metalwork and circle diameter are IDENTICAL in all four cells, at the identical position of each cell — only the named light changes. A bigger or smaller pod in any cell ruins the sheet.
- ABSOLUTE WHEEL LAW: every wheel in all four cells spans exactly 150 px — the plus-cross, the X, the flare and the rim-lit wheel are all the same 150 px circle at the same position, surrounded by flat green key. The wheel's diameter is a fixed 150 px in every cell.
- SAME RING LAW: the amber ring, its rim thickness, the hub and the spoke lengths are identical in all four cells, all well inside the cell with a wide green border — ONLY the spoke pair turns (45 degrees per step). No part grows, shrinks or slides.
- SAME SUBJECT LAW: every cell shows the SAME subject, the same size, the same materials and colours, at the same position in its cell — only the named attitude changes between cells.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 512×512 px. Produce EXACTLY 4 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- CENTRING AND SIZE: every subject sits at the exact centre of its cell at the same scale and position as the other cell — only the named state changes.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — as much detail and inner structure as possible AT that low resolution, crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, signature, blurry, anti-aliasing, smooth gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, drop shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell, cropped subject, subject touching edge
